len.doc: Returns the length of the string in bytes.

bytes.doc: Returns the byte representation of the string as a vector of integers.

chars.doc: Returns the characters of the string as a vector of chars.

lines.doc: Returns the lines of the string.

split.doc: Splits the string by the given separator.

replace.doc: Replaces all occurrences of old with new.

substring.doc: Returns a substring from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive).

trim.doc: Returns the string with leading and trailing whitespace removed.

contains.doc: Returns true if the string contains the substring.

hash.doc: Returns the hash code of the string.

indexOf.doc: Returns the index of the first occurrence of the substring, or Err if not found.

lastIndexOf.doc: Returns the index of the last occurrence of the substring, or Err if not found.

startsWith.doc: Returns true if the string starts with prefix.

endsWith.doc: Returns true if the string ends with suffix.

parseInt.doc: Parses the string as an integer.

parseFloat.doc: Parses the string as a float.

get.doc: Returns the character at index, or Err if out of bounds.

push.doc: Pushes an element to the end of the vector.

append.doc: Appends all elements from another vector.

pop.doc: Removes and returns the last element of the vector, or Err if empty.

remove.doc: Removes and returns the element at the given index.

first.doc: Returns the first element, or Err if empty.

last.doc: Returns the last element, or Err if empty.

get.doc: Returns the element at index, or Err if out of bounds.

len.doc: Returns the number of elements in the vector.

isEmpty.doc: Returns true if the vector has no elements.

clear.doc: Removes all elements from the vector.

contains.doc: Returns true if the vector contains the value.

slice.doc: Returns a sub-vector between start and end.

insert.doc: Inserts or updates a key-value pair.

get.doc: Looks up a key and returns Result<V, string>.

len.doc: Returns the number of key-value pairs in the map.

isEmpty.doc: Returns true if the map has no entries.

keys.doc: Returns a vector of all keys in the map.

values.doc: Returns a vector of all values in the map.

clear.doc: Removes all entries from the map.

remove.doc: Removes and returns the value for the given key.

contains.doc: Returns true if the map contains the given key.

len.doc: Returns the number of key-value pairs in the map.

keys.doc: Returns a vector of all keys in the map.

values.doc: Returns a vector of all values in the map.

clear.doc: Removes all entries from the map.

remove.doc: Removes the entry with the given key.

contains.doc: Returns true if the map contains the given key.

isOk.doc: Returns true if the result is Ok.

isErr.doc: Returns true if the result is Err.

unwrap.doc: Returns the Ok value. Panics if Err.

unwrapErr.doc: Returns the Err value. Panics if Ok.

toString.doc: Returns a string representation of the Result.

withCap.doc: Creates an empty vector with reserved capacity.

from.doc: Creates a dynamic vector from a fixed-size vector.

withCap.doc: Creates an empty hash map with reserved capacity.
